result.instructions: Tools for Weblate, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How complete is each language in my app project?"; "Which strings in German still need translating?"; "Show the translation changes made this week and who made them.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Weblate data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run weblate_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run weblate_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run weblate_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. weblate_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: weblate_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the projects visible to this token: name, slug, website and settings (review workflow, access control). GET /api/projects/.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: weblate_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: One project by slug: name, website, settings, instructions and links. GET /api/projects/{project}/.

project.description: Project slug (the URL name, for example 'hello').

tools.name: weblate_list_components
tools.title: List components
tools.description: List translation components (one translatable file set in a repository), with repository, file mask, source language and status flags. Give a project to list only its components. Repository URLs have embedded credentials removed. GET /api/components/ or /api/projects/{project}/components/.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: weblate_get_component
tools.title: Get component
tools.description: One component: repository, branch, file mask, template, source language, commit and merge settings, lock state. GET /api/components/{project}/{component}/.

project.description: Project slug (the URL name, for example 'hello').

component.description: Component slug. A component inside a category is 'category/component'.

tools.name: weblate_list_translations
tools.title: List translations
tools.description: List the translations (one language each) of a component with their statistics: total, translated, fuzzy, percent, last change. GET /api/components/{project}/{component}/translations/.

project.description: Project slug (the URL name, for example 'hello').

component.description: Component slug. A component inside a category is 'category/component'.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: weblate_get_translation
tools.title: Get translation
tools.description: One translation (a component in one language): statistics, language, file name, revision and links. GET /api/translations/{project}/{component}/{language}/.

project.description: Project slug (the URL name, for example 'hello').

component.description: Component slug. A component inside a category is 'category/component'.

language.description: Language code as Weblate names it (for example 'cs', 'pt_BR', 'zh_Hans').

tools.name: weblate_get_statistics
tools.title: Get translation statistics
tools.description: Translation progress: strings and words total, translated, needing edit, with percentages and checks. Scope by project; add a component for per-language statistics of a component, add a language too for one translation. GET /api/projects/{project}/statistics/, /api/components/{project}/{component}/statistics/ or /api/translations/{project}/{component}/{language}/statistics/.

project.description: Project slug (the URL name, for example 'hello').

component.description: Component slug. A component inside a category is 'category/component'.

language.description: Language code as Weblate names it (for example 'cs', 'pt_BR', 'zh_Hans').

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: weblate_list_project_languages
tools.title: List project languages
tools.description: Per-language translation statistics for a whole project (code, total, translated, percentages). GET /api/projects/{project}/languages/.

project.description: Project slug (the URL name, for example 'hello').

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: weblate_list_languages
tools.title: List languages
tools.description: List the languages known to this Weblate instance: code, name, text direction, plural forms. GET /api/languages/.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: weblate_list_units
tools.title: List strings (units)
tools.description: List or search translation strings (units): source, target, state (0 untranslated, 10 needs editing, 20 translated, 30 approved, 100 read-only), context, location, failing checks. Search with Weblate's query syntax, for example state:<translated or has:suggestion. Give project + component + language to read one translation; without them all visible strings are searched. GET /api/translations/{project}/{component}/{language}/units/ or /api/units/.

project.description: Project slug (the URL name, for example 'hello').

component.description: Component slug. A component inside a category is 'category/component'.

language.description: Language code as Weblate names it (for example 'cs', 'pt_BR', 'zh_Hans').

q.description: Weblate search query (https://docs.weblate.org/en/latest/user/search.html), for example 'state:<translated' or 'source:hello'.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: weblate_get_unit
tools.title: Get string (unit)
tools.description: One string by id: source and target forms, state, context, location, flags, labels, explanation, suggestions/comments flags, web link. GET /api/units/{id}/.

tools.name: weblate_list_unit_comments
tools.title: List string comments
tools.description: Comments on one string (Weblate 5.15+). GET /api/units/{id}/comments/.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: weblate_list_suggestions
tools.title: List suggestions
tools.description: List suggestions (proposed translations waiting for review), newest first (Weblate 2026.8+). Give a unit id for one string's suggestions. GET /api/suggestions/ or /api/units/{id}/suggestions/.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: weblate_list_changes
tools.title: List changes
tools.description: The activity log: who changed or translated what, when, with the action name and the changed text. Scope by project, component or translation (language), or filter by user, action id and time range. GET /api/changes/ or the project/component/translation changes endpoint.

project.description: Project slug (the URL name, for example 'hello').

component.description: Component slug. A component inside a category is 'category/component'.

language.description: Language code as Weblate names it (for example 'cs', 'pt_BR', 'zh_Hans').

action.description: Only these action ids (see Weblate's change actions).

timestamp_after.description: Only changes after this ISO 8601 time.

timestamp_before.description: Only changes before this ISO 8601 time.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: weblate_search_memory
tools.title: Search translation memory
tools.description: Browse the translation memory entries visible to the token, filtered by source text (substring), languages or project. GET /api/memory/.

source.description: Case-insensitive substring of the source text.

project.description: Project slug (the URL name, for example 'hello').

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: weblate_lookup_memory
tools.title: Look up translation memory
tools.description: Find translation memory matches (exact or fuzzy) for up to 20 source strings in one language pair. Read-only: nothing is stored. POST /api/memory/lookup/.

exact.description: Return exact matches only, skipping fuzzy matching.

tools.name: weblate_get_repository_status
tools.title: Get repository status
tools.description: Version-control status: pending changes to commit, upstream changes to merge, changes to push, remote commit, merge failure. For a project (summary of all its repositories) or one component. GET /api/projects/{project}/repository/ or /api/components/{project}/{component}/repository/.

project.description: Project slug (the URL name, for example 'hello').

component.description: Component slug. A component inside a category is 'category/component'.

tools.name: weblate_update_translation
tools.title: Update a translation
tools.description: WRITE: set the translation of one string (replaces the current target). `target` is the list of plural forms. `state` is required (Weblate rejects a partial update without both): 0 untranslated with an empty target, 10 needs editing, 20 translated or 30 approved (approval needs the review workflow and permission). The number of plural forms must match the language. Changes are committed to the repository by Weblate's normal schedule. PATCH /api/units/{id}/.

target.description: The text as a list of plural forms; use a one-element list for a string without plurals.

state.description: New state: 0 untranslated (target must be empty), 10 needs editing, 20 translated, 30 approved.

tools.name: weblate_add_suggestion
tools.title: Add a suggestion
tools.description: WRITE: propose a translation for one string; normally a reviewer accepts it later, but the author's automatic upvote (or an existing identical suggestion) can reach the project's auto-accept threshold and apply it at once. Needs the Add suggestion permission and suggestions enabled (Weblate 2026.8+). POST /api/units/{id}/suggestions/.

target.description: The text as a list of plural forms; use a one-element list for a string without plurals.

tools.name: weblate_accept_suggestion
tools.title: Accept a suggestion
tools.description: WRITE: apply a suggestion to its string (replaces the current translation). `approve` also marks it approved (review workflow and permission needed). Weblate 2026.8+. POST /api/suggestions/{id}/accept/.

tools.name: weblate_add_unit_comment
tools.title: Add a string comment
tools.description: WRITE: add a comment to one string (Markdown, @username mentions notify users). `scope` is global (all languages), translation (this language) or report (a source-string issue report; needs the review workflow). Weblate 5.12+. POST /api/units/{id}/comments/.

tools.name: weblate_repository_operation
tools.title: Run a repository operation
tools.description: WRITE: commit (write pending translations into the local repository), pull (merge upstream changes) or push (publish committed changes to the remote repository) for a project or one component. Push changes the remote repository. reset and cleanup are not offered. POST /api/projects/{project}/repository/ or /api/components/{project}/{component}/repository/.

project.description: Project slug (the URL name, for example 'hello').

component.description: Omit to run the operation on every component of the project.

tools.name: weblate_autotranslate
tools.title: Run automatic translation
tools.description: WRITE: fill a translation automatically from other components (auto_source others, default) or from machine translation (mt, needs engines). `mode` suggest only adds suggestions (default), translate writes translations, fuzzy marks them needing edit. `q` limits it to strings matching a search (default state:<translated, the strings that are not translated yet); threshold is the minimum match score (default 80). Use background to schedule a task instead of waiting. POST /api/translations/{project}/{component}/{language}/autotranslate/.

project.description: Project slug (the URL name, for example 'hello').

component.description: Component slug. A component inside a category is 'category/component'.

language.description: Language code as Weblate names it (for example 'cs', 'pt_BR', 'zh_Hans').

auto_source.description: others = other components (default), mt = machine translation engines (needs engines).

engines.description: Machine translation engine ids; required when auto_source is mt.

background.description: Schedule as a background task and return a task url (Weblate 2026.10+).
